name: com.viitorx.avtar.tracking.cutout
description: Draws the cutout stream (the person cut out of the camera picture) in Unity: CutoutView with its look, mirror and fit options, and two URP shaders (the person and a backdrop). Requires the Universal Render Pipeline.

samples.description: A VisionBootstrap and a scene that draws the person cut out of the camera picture (original, person alone, silhouette; checker, colour or gradient behind). Needs the tracking engine and the Universal Render Pipeline.
